meta.name: give-me-tips
meta.description: Explains any senpi tip in depth - startup tips, working tips, and any Tip: line shown in the TUI (including the Fable-5-refusal fallback tip). Use when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, asks what a tip means, how a tipped feature works, or which tips they can see. Queries the live tip list (senpi --list-tips) first, checks what THIS user can actually see, then verifies the real feature code before explaining.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 深入解释任何senpi提示的含义与用法
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果使用senpi时想弄懂每条提示在说什么
copy.tagline_en: Explain any senpi tip in depth
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to understand what each senpi tip means and how to use it

howto.what: 当用户问起某个 Tip 提示时，Claude 会先查询实时提示列表并核对用户实际可见的提示，再阅读相关功能的源代码，最后用用户的语言给出深入解释，并引用具体文件路径。
howto.when: 当用户问起某个 Tip: 提示的含义、说“give-me-tips”、或询问提示功能的工作原理时触发。

say.text: 我启动时看到一条 Tip，它是什么意思？
say.note: Claude 会查出这条提示并解读

say.text: 解释一下‘Fable 5 拒绝’那条提示的原理
我目前能看到哪些提示？
say.note: Claude 会列出你可见的提示

howto.what_en: When the user asks about a Tip, Claude first queries the live tip list and checks which tips this user can actually see, then reads the relevant feature code, and finally explains it in the user's language with concrete file paths.
howto.when_en: Triggered when the user asks about a Tip: line, says give-me-tips, or asks how a tipped feature works.

say_en.text: I saw a Tip at startup, what does it mean?
say_en.note: Claude will locate and explain that tip.

say_en.text: Explain the Fable-5 refusal tip in detail.
say_en.note: Claude will dig into fallback-architect code.

say_en.text: Which tips am I able to see?
say_en.note: Claude will list your visible tips.
